name: Importance-driven Isosurface Decimation
definition: A parallel mesh decimation strategy that uses transfer functions to define mesh importance based on geometric properties and user-specified features, generating decimated meshes progressively without generating the original surface.
summary: Importance-driven isosurface decimation is a parallel mesh simplification strategy that progressively generates decimated meshes by deciding simplification before mesh generation, avoiding the parallelization difficulties of traditional methods.
